description: Synthetic queries for real Evidence V2 pipeline execution. Not validation. Construction notes document how each fixture was built; BLAST and Evidence decide outcomes. Round 3 adds routing, mid-delta FP, and a 4-mismatch competitive window.

construction_notes.unique_block: Length-ladder TARGET queries are prefixes of UNIQUE_TARGET (100 bp), a block assembled to be unrelated to host/neighbor unique blocks. These samples probe recovery and locus.minimum_candidate_bp at 39/40 and 49/50, not a near-threshold competitive margin.
construction_notes.competitive_windows: Separate 50 bp windows on target_ref are identical to one non-target subject except 1, 2, 3, or 4 transversions. Mismatch counts are a construction hypothesis around minimum_delta_bitscore 5/10/15. Observed BLAST delta is empirical.
construction_notes.hard_negatives: HOST/NEAR_NON_TARGET queries are the mutated competitor windows themselves, so they remain similar to target_ref and can produce a TARGET_VIRUS locus. The mid-delta decoy is the target 2-mismatch window labeled HOST so BLAST may rank TARGET first. Easy contaminant remains poly-T.
construction_notes.routing_49bp: pipe_route_short_only_49bp is a 49 bp query with transversions every 10 bp versus a unique target window. Designed so blastn-short may recover it and conventional blastn may not, discriminating dual_mode_max_bp 48 vs 49. Outcome is empirical.
construction_notes.no_forced_outcome: No fixture asserts TARGET_SPECIFIC, a numeric delta, recovery, or FP.

samples.construction: Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 29 bp (bucket 20–29, blastn-short only). Preserved from v1.
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 30 bp (bucket 30–39, dual-mode start).
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 35 bp (interior of bucket 30–39).
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 39 bp. Boundary vs 40 bp for locus.minimum_candidate_bp=40 (exploratory if min_cand=40).
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 40 bp. Boundary vs 39 bp; LOCUS_CANDIDATE if min_cand=40, exploratory if min_cand is 45 or 50. Preserved from v1.
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 49 bp. Boundary vs 50 bp for min_cand=50 and for blast.dual_mode_max_bp 48 vs 49. Preserved from v1.
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 50 bp. Boundary vs 49 bp; blastn-only; LOCUS_CANDIDATE for all grid min_cand values.
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 51 bp. Just above the 50 bp blastn / min_cand public boundary.
Exact prefix of UNIQUE_TARGET, 79 bp (bucket 50–99). Preserved from v1.
Full UNIQUE_TARGET, 100 bp (bucket ≥100). Preserved from v1.

Query is the first 49 bp of the target host-1-mismatch window. host_ref matches this window except one transversion at index 12. Designed so BLAST margin may fall near delta=5; dual_mode_max_bp 48 vs 49 also applies at 49 bp. Outcome is empirical.
Query is the 50 bp target host-1-mismatch window. host_ref has one transversion at index 12. Designed so conventional blastn margin may fall near delta=5. Outcome is empirical.
Query is the 50 bp target host-2-mismatch window. host_ref_2mm has transversions at indices 12 and 24. Designed so BLAST margin may fall near delta=10. Outcome is empirical.
Query is the 50 bp target neighbor-3-mismatch window. neighbor_ref has transversions at indices 12, 24 and 36. Designed so BLAST margin may fall near delta=15. Outcome is empirical.

Query is the 50 bp target neighbor-4-mismatch window. neighbor_ref has transversions at indices 12, 24, 36 and 48. Designed so conventional blastn margin may meet or exceed delta=15. Outcome is empirical.

Query is the 49 bp routing probe: the unique target window with transversions every 10 bp so 11-mers break and 7-mers remain. Designed so recovery may depend on whether blastn-short runs (dual_mode_max_bp=49) or only conventional blastn (dual_mode_max_bp=48). Outcome is empirical.

Query is the HOST version of the 1-mismatch window (one transversion vs target window). Ground truth is HOST. Tests whether a TARGET_VIRUS locus is still recovered (FP risk). No expected call is asserted.
Query is the HOST version of the 2-mismatch window. Slightly more distant from target_ref than pipe_fp_hostlike_50bp. Ground truth HOST; FP if a TARGET_VIRUS candidate is recovered.
Query is the NEIGHBOR version of the 3-mismatch window. Ground truth NEAR_NON_TARGET_VIRUS; FP if a TARGET_VIRUS candidate is recovered.

Host-labeled decoy identical to the target 2-mismatch FP window. host_ref has transversions at indices 12 and 24. Designed so BLAST may rank TARGET first with a margin between 5 and 10, separating minimum_delta_bitscore=5 from 10/15 on TARGET_SPECIFIC. Outcome is empirical.
Poly-T 49 bp easy negative. Preserved from v1. Not a near-target FP probe.
